temporal_notes: Larval collections were conducted between April and November 2018.
species_id_method: PCR (SINE200 insertion polymorphism, Santolamazza et al. 2008)
coord_source_text: The study was conducted in Tchonka (GPS coordinates 2°19'20.29''S, 27°32'25.90''E), a village located in the health district of Lulingu in the territory of Shabunda in the Sud-Kivu province of the DRC (Figure 1).
source_text: In total, 236 mosquitoes from A. funestus group and A. gambiae complex were successfully identified by PCR. Mosquito populations were composed of 97 A. funestus s.s. and 139 A. gambiae s.s.
